blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A short video showing suitcases inside the alleged Forbes Park residence of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez was presented on Monday during the Sandiganbayan Third Division’s hearing on his bail petition for plunder. The court allowed the showing of a 13-second video clip during the testimony of George Villalon Jr., one of the so-called “Maleta boys.” READ: ‘Maleta boys’ to testify vs Romualdez in plunder bail hearing Villalon, a witness presented by special prosecutors, told the court that he shot that clip using a cellphone on November 21, 2023, at around 2 p.m. When Deputy Special Prosecutor Omar Sagadal […]...
